notes.title: Performance optimization update
notes.notes:
1. Add road guidance within levels.

2. Optimize some experiences of cruise ships.

3. Remove the collision of windmills and make them merely decorative.

4. Enhance the road traffic system.

5. Performance optimization of the large map, reaching 150 frames per second.

6. The issue of freezing has been resolved. Currently, a significant number of freezing problems have been reduced. If it still occurs, we will continue to address it in the future.

notes.title: A major update to the open world
notes.notes:
Dear Players,
Thank you for your continued support and interest! The latest demo version now includes the following content for you to explore:
Open World Areas
Central City

Airport

Beach

Industrial Zone

Mountain Area
UI Features (Preview)
Trophy System

Leaderboard

In-Game Store

World Map

Inventory & Equipment Interface
Current Version Notes[olist]
This is a work-in-progress demo and does not represent the final quality of the game. Some features are still being optimized.

The World Map may occasionally experience stuttering—we are actively improving performance.

UI functions are currently for demonstration purposes only, with some interactions not yet fully implemented.

Multi-language support is not yet available and will be added in future updates.

The tutorial system is still being adjusted, which may affect the initial experience.

City traffic systems have not been implemented and will be introduced in the full release.
[/olist]
We highly value your feedback! If you encounter any issues or have suggestions for improvement, please feel free to reach out through our official channels.

Thank you once again for your support. We look forward to growing and improving the game with you!

— Development Team

notes.title: The Demo of "Rider Valkyries" has undergone a major update
notes.notes:
Based on feedback from some friends, I've made the following updates. The current demo offers significantly improved gameplay—you're welcome to try it out!
[olist]
Improved hit feedback: Added real-time sound effects to make combat more impactful and immersive.

Police are in! What’s a violent motorcycle game without the cops? Be careful not to get caught by the police ladies—they’ll throw you in jail for a big communal meal! Of course... you could also dominate them if you prefer.

Collision logic added: Knocking girls off their bikes now heals you. Didn’t see that coming, did you? (But remember: it's just a game—don't try this in real life!)

Vehicles added: They're heavy and tough. You're squishy and fast. Be careful not to get hit, or you'll go flying! Safety first—unless you like being laughed at by your friends.

Camera improved: Reduced motion sickness during ragdoll-style collisions.

Lighting tweaks: Fixed overexposure issues in some scenes.

Stuck bug fixes: Optimized terrain and object colliders to prevent getting trapped.

Map collision optimization: Reduced small-object collisions for smoother driving.

Victory & restart logic: Now you can officially win (and start over) the game.

Control remap: Adjusted key settings to match the classic Road Rash feel.

Melee & kick animations tuned: Improved the rhythm and timing of attacks.

Weapon pickup system added: Defeat other riders to get weapons!
[/olist]
